title: What drew Duke to Jones: a shared approach to writing
summary: Willard asks why Duke collected Jones; he cannot pinpoint it beyond liking his playing and writing.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: What do you think was your special affinity with Duke, because Duke would spot people whom he felt a kinship with, or else he wanted their talents to enrich his own, and it had to be something specific. It

wasn't just that he liked somebody or he thought they were competent. There had to be something very special for Duke to collect you, and you were among the people whom Duke collected close. What do you think it was? What was the meeting ground?
You know, Pat, it's awfully hard to -- he liked my playing, he liked my writing, and it's awfully hard to pinpoint it, you know? It's almost like you start drifting together.
Do you think there was a similarity in your approaches in writing that --
